Ruijie Networks.why: Sells data-center Ethernet switches (400G / 800G, 128-port 800G box switch) to internet customers' AI computing-center networks; data-center switch revenue from internet customers was the core driver of its H1 2026 growth (revenue +32.83%), so AI cluster scale-out networking build-out directly drives its sales.
Ruijie Networks.evidence: Ruijie Networks half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026): the company's AI computing-center network solutions have served the large-model training and inference applications of China Mobile, Alibaba, ByteDance, Baidu, Tencent, Kuaishou, 360 and others; accelerated delivery of data-center switch orders for internet customers drove sharp revenue growth and was the core driver of H1 2026 results.

players.product: 400G/800G data-center Ethernet switches for AI computing clusters (128-port 800G box switch; 51.2T CPO co-packaged switch solution), plus 1.6T/800G optical modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical modules (annual report): in 2025 the company launched 1.6T/800G optical module products, matched to the data-center switches and overall solutions bought by leading internet customers, for high-speed server-to-switch interconnect. It also launched its new-generation 128-port 800G switch and released the 51.2T CPO switch commercial interconnect solution, which it says offers a path to future 800G and 1.6T network upgrades.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI networking R&D (annual report): FY2025 R&D investment RMB 2,085,714,991.69, 14.57% of revenue (18.74% in 2024), RMB 87,642,541.07 capitalised; 3,359 R&D staff (50.28% of employees). Completed: new 100G/400G small-core switches and 400G line-rate switch line cards for large-model computing centers. In development: a hundred-terabit (100T) series of switches with LPO optical modules and AIDC scheduling software for large-model developers, computing-cloud providers and GPU makers (the Ruijie AIDC network system), and an AI computing cabinet supporting single-cabinet, back-to-back and cluster scale-up modes (the Ruijie super-node system).

quarterly_data.quarter: Ruijie Networks annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 plan (annual report): the company will keep its '124' operating policy - strengthen innovation and operations and accelerate culture, talent, overseas expansion and AI adoption - focusing on three networks (cloud computing centers, enterprise campuses and small and medium enterprises) plus security and cloud desktop; it plans to keep raising R&D investment and build a globally competitive supply chain to secure stable delivery. No numeric target given.
